title: Anatomy of an Agent Harness: Decisions, Invariants and Corner Cases
abstract: arXiv:2611.19960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent harness is the program around a language model that turns its replies into actions: it builds each request, runs the tools the model asks for, decides what the model may do without asking, stores the conversation, recovers from failures, and shows a person what happened. Most of these decisions are made in code and rarely written down, so each harness meets the same corner cases again. This paper writes them down as invariants to test. It gives a system model with trust boundaries; 30 decision cards in six groups, each with options and costs, an invariant, the corner cases that break it, a test and an evidence tag; six cause classes for failures; a test method built on scripted providers, recorded behaviour and planted changes; and a checklist. The cards come from building one desktop harness, Crewroom, the author's own, and from manually testing ten other harnesses and studying open-source harnesses as reference; some patterns

translated_title: 智能体框架剖析：决策、不变量与边界情况
translated_abstract: 智能体框架是围绕语言模型运行的程序，它将模型的回复转化为行动：它负责构建每次请求、运行模型所要求的工具、决定模型可以在无需询问的情况下执行哪些操作、存储对话内容、从故障中恢复，并向人类展示发生了什么。这些决策大多隐含在代码中而很少被记录下来，因此每个框架都会一再遇到相同的边界情况。本文将这些决策记录下来，形成可测试的不变量。论文提出了一个带信任边界的系统模型；六组共30张决策卡，每张卡包含选项及其代价、一个不变量、破坏该不变量的边界情况、一个测试和一个证据标签；六类故障成因；一种基于脚本化提供者、记录行为和植入变更的测试方法；以及一份检查清单。这些决策卡来源于作者自行构建的一个桌面框架 Crewroom、对其他十个框架的人工测试，以及以开源框架为参考的研究；部分模式……
tldr: 本文首次将智能体框架中隐含于代码、鲜有记录的关键工程决策系统化为六组30张“决策卡”——每张包含选项与代价、可测试的不变量、破坏性边界情况、测试与证据标签——并配套提供带信任边界的系统模型、六类故障成因、基于脚本化提供者的测试方法与检查清单，为智能体框架的健壮性设计与测试建立了系统化方法论。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes the undocumented engineering decisions of agent harnesses into 30 decision cards across six groups—each with options, costs, a testable invariant, breaking corner cases, a test, and an evidence tag—supported by a trust-boundary system model, six failure cause classes, a scripted-provider testing method, and a checklist for building robust agent harnesses.
